Overview of Canton of Valais Region (Valais / Wallis)

Canton of Valais Region (Valais / Wallis) is located in the Canton of Valais region of Switzerland, with its prefectural capital at Sion. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Zermatt, Matterhorn & Gornergrat, Aletsch Arena & Great Aletsch Glacier, Saas-Fee & Verbier alpine resorts, Sion castles & Lavaux/Valais vineyards.

RegionCanton of Valais
Capital citySion
Cities & municipalities28
Primary transport hubSion Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)

How to get to Canton of Valais Region

Simplon rail line via Brig and Visp; Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn to Zermatt and Glacier Express route. Use our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Canton of Valais

When visiting cities across Canton of Valais, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Valais Raclette AOP
  • Cholera savory pastry
  • Valais dried beef (Trockenfleisch)
  • Petite Arvine & Fendant wines

Best time to visit Canton of Valais

Best time to visit Canton of Valais: Jun–Sep (hiking), Dec–Apr (skiing).
